preconditions.description: The number of elements in the given array is between 2 and 100000, inclusive.
The number of elements that can be changed is between 0 and the minimum of 10 or N-2, inclusive.
Each element in the given array is between -10^9 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Output is a single line containing N space-separated integers
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of N integers that represents the resulting array after at most K changes, forming an arithmetic progression with the most beautiful definition.
